editorial:
Imagine you are a politician trying to win a big election, but then someone catches you on camera smoking crack. That is exactly the mess you get into in this wild ride. You will follow a mayor who is totally panicking and will do anything to stop that video from going public. It feels like a chaotic day where everything that can go wrong actually does. The movie has a gritty but funny vibe, mixing crime elements with a lot of loud, fast energy that keeps you wondering how much worse things can get for our unlucky main character.

You will probably love the fast pacing and the way the comedy hits just when things get too tense. While some of the acting is a bit over the top, it actually fits the crazy story perfectly. The action scenes are punchy and keep the story moving without dragging. If you have a decent setup at home, you should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the detail, or you could grab the 4K Blu-ray to keep in your physical collection. It is a great pick for a lazy Friday night with friends.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the mayor tries to buy back the footage one last time. After a series of fights and double-crosses, the video finally leaks to the public. You see the mayor lose his power and reputation in an instant. He ends up completely ruined, proving that you cannot hide your secrets forever. The movie wraps up with a funny look at how fast fame can turn into a total disaster.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and chaotic crime stories.
